topic: Chat, Cowork, or Claude Code: which one do I use?
post:
New to Claude? Start here. 👋
Chat, Cowork, or Claude Code: which one should you actually use?

Here's the simplest way I can explain it:

💬 Chat = ask and get answers
Questions, drafts, brainstorming, explaining things.

🗂️ Cowork = hand off a whole task
You describe the result. Claude plans the steps and does the work with your files and apps.
Think: organizing a folder, turning notes into a report, cleaning up a spreadsheet.

💻 Claude Code = build and fix software
Made for coding work, and you still ask for things in plain English.

A great first Cowork task:
"Turn my meeting notes into a one-page summary with action items and owners."

One habit that matters:
Cowork shows you its plan before it acts. Read it, approve it, and check the result, especially with important files.

Good to know: Cowork is on paid Claude plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise).

Why it matters:
Most people only use AI as a chatbot. The real time savings start when you hand off the task, not just the question.

What's one task you'd hand to Cowork this week? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
